segments.text: 17 As for theſe fower children God gaue them knowledge and vnderſtanding in all wiſedome: alſo he gaue Daniell vnderſtanding of all viſions and dreames.

18 Now when the time was expired that the king had appointed to bring them in, the chiefe of the Eunuches brought thē before Nebuchadnezer. And the king communed with them, and among them all was found none like Daniel. &c.
